title: RPLSS: A randomized projected linear systems solver
summary: The projected linear system solver (PLSS), by incrementally appending columns to a random or deterministic sketching matrix, provides an attractive finite termination property for consistent linear systems. Nevertheless, a critical computational bottleneck of PLSS is accessing the whole coefficient matrix per iteration, making it prohibitive for extremely large-scale problems or applications with missing data.
